research.methodology: Retrieved up to 50 most-recent written US App Store reviews per competitor from Apple’s public customer-review feed. Screened 1–3-star records for relevant comparison topics and inspected selected examples alongside current listings, release notes and visible developer replies. Every rating in the returned sample contributes to sampleSize; only selected critical examples are paraphrased below. These are qualitative examples, not a representative survey, a defect rate or a cross-app quality ranking. Dates displayed in the article use Asia/Singapore; raw Apple timestamps and versions are retained.
research.reviewStatus: User-reported experiences; current reproduction and resolution are not verified unless explicitly stated. The RSS feed does not supply developer replies; contextual replies come from the linked public App Store page and may concern other, older reviews.
research.selectionPolicy: Prefer recent, specific usability, advertising and feature-access concerns that map to a documented feature of our app. Preserve contrary developer context and version differences. Selected user reports do not establish overall reliability. A feed with no written entries supplies no adverse inference.
research.scope: US public feeds, first page sorted mostRecent; 11 apps; sample windows differ substantially.
research.rateComparisonConclusion: Conversion Calculator Plus documents one-minute active Currency+ checks. Four rivals explicitly state slower automatic schedules: Units Plus daily; Currency converter calculator! and GlobeConvert hourly; Converter+ every six hours or on request. The other seven reviewed descriptions do not specify a numeric automatic interval.

apps.name: Unit Converter - Best Unit App
apps.reportedConcern: Selected October 2026 reviews of version 10.2 report full-screen ads or advertising obstructing input.
apps.ourDocumentedResponse: Conversion Calculator Plus documents no full-page ads; the free version uses banners. This directly addresses the full-screen interruption concern. Premium removes banners.
apps.limitations: These reports describe selected sessions. Overall ad frequency and present-day input layout have not been independently measured.
apps.developerAndReleaseContext: The selected review version matches the current listing. No response to these selected reviews was available in the reviewed feed; current resolution is unknown.

examples.paraphrase: Reported full-screen advertising and frustration with feature paywalls.

apps.name: Currency converter calculator!
apps.reportedConcern: Selected August and October 2026 reviewers report screen-blocking or full-screen ads.
apps.ourDocumentedResponse: Our app documents banner-only advertising with no full-page ads, plus one-minute active Currency+ checks versus this rival’s published hourly schedule.
apps.limitations: The selected reviews precede current version 3.1.10. Its release notes say bug fixes without identifying these complaints; current reproduction is unknown.
apps.developerAndReleaseContext: Older highlighted App Store reviews about purchase restoration and a 2024 currency-selection problem include resolution reports or a developer fix. Those are excluded as evidence of current defects.

examples.paraphrase: Reported an ad blocking the screen during an exchange-rate lookup.
Reported a full-screen ad that was difficult to dismiss.

apps.name: Unit Converter - Convert all
apps.reportedConcern: October 2026 reviewers describe ads interrupting first use and difficulty with fractional input or paid conversion access.
apps.ourDocumentedResponse: Our no-full-page-ad policy addresses interruption. Our supported expression input can calculate 1 ÷ 8 before conversion; ordinary measurement categories are not listed as Premium requirements.
apps.limitations: The rival itself advertises an expression calculator. A reviewer’s fraction-entry difficulty is not proof it cannot calculate division or that our input is uniquely capable.
apps.developerAndReleaseContext: An older 2017 decimal-key complaint has a developer reply saying it was fixed; a 2018 purchase-restoration complaint was also resolved. Neither is used as a current defect claim.

examples.paraphrase: Reported too many ads before completing a first conversion.
Reported difficulty entering an inch fraction and disliked paying for less-used conversions.

apps.name: My Currency Converter & Rates
apps.reportedConcern: One September 2026 reviewer criticized navigation effort on version 26.5.1.
apps.ourDocumentedResponse: Currency+ compares several currencies together, and favorites and conversion history support repeat work. These are concrete workflow options for users who dislike repeated setup.
apps.limitations: This is a subjective report, not a tap-count benchmark or proof our app is universally easier. Other sampled and highlighted reviews praise this rival’s simplicity.
apps.developerAndReleaseContext: Current version 26.6.2 release notes explicitly mention design improvements, so the older navigation concern may have changed. Current resolution was not tested.

examples.paraphrase: Reported frustration with the number of interactions needed to change a setting or value.

apps.name: Convert Any Unit Lite
apps.reportedConcern: Selected July and September 2026 reviews of version 6.8 report intrusive ads interrupting conversion or unit selection.
apps.ourDocumentedResponse: Our published no-full-page-ad policy offers a concrete alternative to full-screen interruptions. Premium removes our banner ads.
apps.limitations: Our free version still has banners. These individual reports do not establish an overall failure rate or the behavior of every rival session.
apps.developerAndReleaseContext: The selected reviews match current version 6.8. A separate older developer reply says the Lite rebranding retained the same app; that does not resolve the selected ad reports. Current reproduction is unknown.

examples.paraphrase: Reported ads appearing when changing measurement units.
Reported ads that were difficult to close and said restarting the app was necessary.

apps.name: Metric Conversion tool
apps.reportedConcern: Selected October 2026 reviews criticize advertising, including a report against current version 3.0.0.
apps.ourDocumentedResponse: Our documented policy limits the free app to banner ads, with no full-page ads. Premium removes banners. This establishes our policy, not a measured ad-quality advantage.
apps.limitations: The selected reports establish dissatisfaction with advertising, but do not identify every ad’s format. Our free app also contains banners.
apps.developerAndReleaseContext: A March 2025 developer response says an earlier ad-quality and music problem was addressed in an update. That historical complaint is not presented as an unresolved current issue.

examples.paraphrase: Reported unwanted advertising after an update.

apps.name: Units - Conversion Calculator
apps.reportedConcern: No written review entries were returned by the selected US feed.
apps.ourDocumentedResponse: Our published category count and Currency+ workflow can still be compared using product descriptions; no review-based weakness is established.
apps.limitations: No written entries in this feed does not mean no ratings, no reviews elsewhere or no defects. The rival advertises no ads, so we do not claim an advertising advantage.

apps.name: GlobeConvert Currency & Units
apps.reportedConcern: Selected August and October 2026 reviews of version 2.2.8 criticize lengthy or recurring ads.
apps.ourDocumentedResponse: Our app documents no full-page ads. Currency+ also checks rates every minute while active and connected, versus GlobeConvert’s stated hourly updates.
apps.limitations: The reports do not establish which actions triggered each ad. Both products offer saved-rate offline use and an ad-free paid option.
apps.developerAndReleaseContext: In a separate 2024 App Store reply, the developer says ads appear for extra functionality and not ordinary conversion. That narrower scope is preserved alongside the later user complaints; current reproduction was not tested.

apps.name: Conversion Calculator Units
apps.reportedConcern: Selected 2025–2026 reviews report navigation difficulty and ad interruptions on older versions.
apps.ourDocumentedResponse: Our app offers category/unit search, favorites and a choice of Simple or Carousel, plus no full-page ads. These are documented alternatives for those needs.
apps.limitations: The cited reviews concern versions 1.8 and 1.7.2, not current 1.9; their complaints must not be presented as confirmed current defects.
apps.developerAndReleaseContext: Version 1.9 release notes mention stability, performance and user-experience improvements. Whether the selected issues remain is unknown.

examples.paraphrase: Reported difficulty switching from volume to other conversion categories.
Reported ads that could not be skipped or paused.

apps.name: Unit Converter - Pro Units App
apps.reportedConcern: A 2023 reviewer objected to paid feature access; the current listing independently confirms that only four categories are unlocked by default.
apps.ourDocumentedResponse: Our ordinary measurement categories are not listed as Premium-gated. Premium is described as removing banners and unlocking interactive widgets and Siri.
apps.limitations: The review is historical, but the four-category free-tier restriction is a current publisher-documented fact. We do not infer unresolved purchase-restoration bugs.
apps.developerAndReleaseContext: Current version 2.1.3 was checked. The comparison relies on its current description for the free-tier restriction, not solely on the older review.

examples.paraphrase: Disliked discovering that only part of the app was available without paying.

apps.name: Converter+ (Units, Currencies)
apps.reportedConcern: An August 2026 reviewer of current version 3.6 requested dark mode.
apps.ourDocumentedResponse: Our app explicitly supports light and dark appearance and one-minute active Currency+ checks, compared with the rival’s stated six-hour automatic schedule or manual refresh.
apps.limitations: A feature request is not independent proof that dark mode is absent. Current rival dark-mode behavior has not been independently tested.
apps.developerAndReleaseContext: The current listing remains version 3.6. We report the dark-mode request as user feedback and use the published refresh interval for the rate comparison.

examples.paraphrase: Requested dark-mode support, while otherwise describing the app positively.
